picture.alt: Daytime: bright sunlight, blue sky and green trees in the window behind them, no lamp on. A boy and a girl look at one open workbook. The boy frowns, points at one written sentence on the page and holds his head: he is puzzled by it. The girl holds a plain ballpoint pen over the page, her other hand on her chin. There is no computer, phone or tablet anywhere in the picture. Far behind them, through an open door into another room, writing brushes hang on a wooden stand; nobody holds a brush and there is no brush, ink or calligraphy paper on their table.

versions.alt: A calligraphy class in a classroom with a clean blackboard: at the front the teacher writes with a big writing brush to show the class, while a boy and a girl sit at their desks with brushes, ink and white paper and watch her before they practice.

prompt.traditional: 我們用＿＿寫書法。
prompt.simplified: 我们用＿＿写书法。

answer.english: We write calligraphy with a brush.

questions.why: Calligraphy is written with a writing brush (毛筆), like the ones in the picture, not with a pencil or a computer.

prompt.traditional: 書法課從兩點＿＿四點。
prompt.simplified: 书法课从两点＿＿四点。

answer.pinyin: Shūfǎ kè cóng liǎng diǎn dào sì diǎn.
answer.english: Calligraphy class is from two to four.

questions.why: 從 … 到 … gives a span of time: from two until four. 和 joins two things, not a start and an end, and 再 means then.

prompt.traditional: 我們在＿＿上書法課。
prompt.simplified: 我们在＿＿上书法课。

answer.pinyin: Wǒmen zài jiàoshì shàng shūfǎ kè.
answer.english: We have calligraphy class in the classroom.

questions.why: The picture shows a classroom with a blackboard and desks, so the class is in the 教室. The dorm (宿舍) and the library (圖書館) are other places to study, not this room.

versions.alt: A calligraphy class in a classroom with a clean blackboard: at the front the teacher writes with a big writing brush to show the class, while a boy and a girl sit at their desks with brushes, ink and white paper and watch her before they practice.

prompt.traditional: 我只會寫這幾個字，＿＿字我都不會寫。
prompt.simplified: 我只会写这几个字，＿＿字我都不会写。

answer.traditional: 我只會寫這幾個字，別的字我都不會寫。
answer.simplified: 我只会写这几个字，别的字我都不会写。
answer.pinyin: Wǒ zhǐ huì xiě zhè jǐ ge zì, biéde zì wǒ dōu bú huì xiě.
answer.english: I can only write these few characters; I can't write any other characters.

questions.why: 別的 + a noun means other: 別的字, the other characters. 別人 means other people, and 每 needs a measure word (每個字).

prompt.traditional: 你看，老師＿＿寫書法，我們先看。
prompt.simplified: 你看，老师＿＿写书法，我们先看。

answer.traditional: 你看，老師在寫書法，我們先看。
answer.simplified: 你看，老师在写书法，我们先看。
answer.pinyin: Nǐ kàn, lǎoshī zài xiě shūfǎ, wǒmen xiān kàn.
answer.english: Look, the teacher is writing calligraphy. Let's watch first.

questions.why: 在 before a verb says the action is happening now: the teacher is writing while the students watch (我們先看). 再 sounds the same but means then (later), and the picture shows her writing, so 不 (not) is wrong.

prompt.traditional: 我每天都練習，我的書法＿＿了。
prompt.simplified: 我每天都练习，我的书法＿＿了。

answer.traditional: 我每天都練習，我的書法進步了。
answer.simplified: 我每天都练习，我的书法进步了。
answer.pinyin: Wǒ měitiān dōu liànxí, wǒ de shūfǎ jìnbù le.
answer.english: I practice every day, and my calligraphy has improved.

questions.why: 進步 means to improve: daily practice made her calligraphy better. 聰明 and 緊張 describe people, not calligraphy.

passage.traditional: 明天有華語考試，我有一點{1}。今天下午我{2}去圖書館寫作業，再回宿舍練習寫字。我的同學非常聰明，他寫字寫{3}又快又好看，{4}我常常問他字怎麼寫。希望明天的考試不難！
passage.simplified: 明天有华语考试，我有一点{1}。今天下午我{2}去图书馆写作业，再回宿舍练习写字。我的同学非常聪明，他写字写{3}又快又好看，{4}我常常问他字怎么写。希望明天的考试不难！
passage.pinyin: Míngtiān yǒu Huáyǔ kǎoshì, wǒ yǒu yìdiǎn jǐnzhāng. Jīntiān xiàwǔ wǒ xiān qù túshūguǎn xiě zuòyè, zài huí sùshè liànxí xiě zì. Wǒ de tóngxué fēicháng cōngmíng, tā xiě zì xiě de yòu kuài yòu hǎokàn, suǒyǐ wǒ chángcháng wèn tā zì zěnme xiě. Xīwàng míngtiān de kǎoshì bù nán!
passage.english: There's a Chinese test tomorrow, and I'm a little nervous. This afternoon I'll go to the library first to do my homework, then go back to the dorm to practice writing characters. My classmate is very smart. He writes characters fast and neatly, so I often ask him how to write them. I hope tomorrow's test isn't hard!

bank.english: (links an action to how it is done)

questions.why: 有一點 goes with an unwelcome feeling: before a test you feel 緊張, nervous.
先 … 再 … puts two actions in order: the library first, then (再) back to the dorm.
得 joins an action to how it is done: 寫字寫得又快又好看.
所以 gives the result: he writes well, so I often ask him how to write characters.

passage.traditional: 我們{1}考試了。老師說我中文說得{2}好，可是寫字寫得很慢。我想請朋友教我寫字。他最近很忙，可是這個週末他{3}有空，我不知道。我不想問{4}，我想等他。我希望他能教我寫很多字。
passage.simplified: 我们{1}考试了。老师说我中文说得{2}好，可是写字写得很慢。我想请朋友教我写字。他最近很忙，可是这个周末他{3}有空，我不知道。我不想问{4}，我想等他。我希望他能教我写很多字。
passage.pinyin: Wǒmen kuàiyào kǎoshì le. Lǎoshī shuō wǒ Zhōngwén shuō de fēicháng hǎo, kěshì xiě zì xiě de hěn màn. Wǒ xiǎng qǐng péngyǒu jiāo wǒ xiě zì. Tā zuìjìn hěn máng, kěshì zhège zhōumò tā yěxǔ yǒu kòng, wǒ bù zhīdào. Wǒ bù xiǎng wèn biérén, wǒ xiǎng děng tā. Wǒ xīwàng tā néng jiāo wǒ xiě hěn duō zì.
passage.english: We're about to have a test. My teacher says I speak Chinese very well, but I write characters slowly. I want to ask a friend to teach me to write characters. He's busy lately, but maybe he's free this weekend; I don't know. I don't want to ask anyone else; I'll wait for him. I hope he can teach me to write lots of characters.

questions.why: 快要 … 了 means something is about to happen: the test is coming soon.
非常 means very and goes between 得 and 好: the teacher says the speaking is very good, but (可是) the writing is slow.
也許 means maybe, and 我不知道 shows the writer is not sure: 這個週末他也許有空. 非常 cannot describe something you don't know, and 常常 (often) does not fit one weekend.
別人 means other people: the writer does not want to ask anyone else, so they wait for the friend.

text.traditional:
中明：
禮拜三我們去機場看飛機吧！坐計程車太貴了，我們坐捷運去。九點我在捷運站等你。
國安

中明：
礼拜三我们去机场看飞机吧！坐计程车太贵了，我们坐捷运去。九点我在捷运站等你。
国安
text.pinyin: Zhōngmíng: Lǐbàisān wǒmen qù jīchǎng kàn fēijī ba! Zuò jìchéngchē tài guì le, wǒmen zuò jiéyùn qù. Jiǔ diǎn wǒ zài jiéyùn zhàn děng nǐ. Guó'ān
text.english: Zhongming: Let's go to the airport on Wednesday and watch the planes! A taxi is too expensive, so we'll take the MRT. I'll wait for you at the MRT station at nine. Guoan

prompt.traditional: 國安九點在哪裡等中明？
prompt.simplified: 国安九点在哪里等中明？
prompt.pinyin: Guó'ān jiǔ diǎn zài nǎlǐ děng Zhōngmíng?
prompt.english: Where will Guoan wait for Zhongming at nine?

questions.why: 九點我在捷運站等你: he waits at the MRT station. The airport is where they are going, and he says a taxi is too expensive.

text.traditional:
友美：
妳網球打得很好，禮拜六上午我們一起去打網球，好嗎？下午我要去游泳，晚上我們一起吃飯吧！
宜文
text.simplified:
友美：
你网球打得很好，礼拜六上午我们一起去打网球，好吗？下午我要去游泳，晚上我们一起吃饭吧！
宜文
text.pinyin: Yǒuměi: Nǐ wǎngqiú dǎ de hěn hǎo, lǐbàiliù shàngwǔ wǒmen yìqǐ qù dǎ wǎngqiú, hǎo ma? Xiàwǔ wǒ yào qù yóuyǒng, wǎnshàng wǒmen yìqǐ chī fàn ba! Yíwén
text.english: Youmei: You play tennis really well. Shall we play tennis together on Saturday morning? In the afternoon I'm going swimming. Let's have dinner together in the evening! Yiwen

prompt.traditional: 宜文禮拜六上午想做什麼？
prompt.simplified: 宜文礼拜六上午想做什么？
prompt.pinyin: Yíwén lǐbàiliù shàngwǔ xiǎng zuò shénme?
prompt.english: What does Yiwen want to do on Saturday morning?

questions.why: For 上午 she writes 我們一起去打網球，好嗎: she wants to play tennis with Youmei. Swimming is in the afternoon (下午) and eating together in the evening (晚上).
